pilot.recruit: Organisers aged 18–25 studying at EFAP Paris, who tried to plan something with a group of 3 to 6 friends in the last month. Their friends may study or work anywhere.
pilot.window: Groups start 1–4 Dec 2026; meetups must happen by Fri 18 Dec (14 days for each group, before the holidays).

primary.name: Group meet-up rate
primary.formula: Groups that actually met within 14 days ÷ groups that started the trial
primary.why: Same bar as the success criterion already written in our working document: at least 3 groups out of 5 meet within 2 weeks.

definitions.started: Started group: an organiser signed up and at least 2 friends received the invitation (group of 3+ people).
definitions.confirmed: Confirmed date: every member of the group voted for the same slot in the planning poll (5/5, 4/4…). It is an intention.
definitions.met: Met: the next morning, at least 2 members (including one who is not the organiser) answer « yes, we met » in the check-in poll. It is a behaviour.

funnel.metric: Organisers who send the invite to their group ÷ organisers signed up
Friends who send their free evenings within 48 h ÷ friends invited
Groups with a confirmed date ÷ groups started
Groups that met ÷ groups with a confirmed date

calendar.what: Ask EFAP for the hall (2 lunch slots) and poster spots; contact the student union (BDE) for relays; write the pilot privacy notice.
Print posters, board, grids, cards; set up the pilot WhatsApp number and Google Sheet; dry-run the pilot with 1 team group.
Shoot the 28-second film (3 h) and edit it.
Posters go up on campus. C1 carousel « Le dico des promesses de groupe » posted.
Activation day 1 (12:00–14:00). Film posted as Reel at 8 pm. Pilot opens.
C2 carousel « Comment ça marche » posted. First slot polls sent to groups.
Sign-ups close (last call story). Mid-point check of the funnel.
Pilot runs: slot polls, reminders (day before + 2 h before), check-in the morning after each meetup.
End survey + 5 short calls (groups that did not lock a date). Count results, decision meeting on Mon 21 Dec.
